subclasses.name: Banner Warden
subclasses.excerpt: A standard-bearer who rallies allies and holds the line.
subclasses.text: Banner Wardens carry their company's colors into battle. Where the banner stands, the line holds.

features.name: Colors of the Company
features.excerpt: Proficiency in Persuasion; Advantage on saves against being Frightened.
features.text: You gain proficiency in the Persuasion skill, and you have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Frightened condition.

advantages.when: to avoid or end the Frightened condition

features.name: Stalwart Bearer
features.excerpt: +1 Hit Point maximum per Fighter level.
features.text: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 1 for each Fighter level you have.

features.name: Raise the Banner
features.excerpt: Bonus Action, 1 Rallying Cry: +1 AC and +10 feet of Speed until you lower it.
features.text: As a Bonus Action, you can expend one use of Rallying Cries to raise your banner. While it is raised, you gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class and your Speed increases by 10 feet.

features.name: Unbroken Line
features.text: You have Resistance to Psychic damage.
